title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
excerpt: Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows PCs, allowing them to be used as a locally run AI system.
content_html:
Jess Weatherbed

is a news writer focused on creative industries, computing, and internet culture. Jess started her career at TechRadar, covering news and hardware reviews.

Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, allowing computers running the world’s most popular OS to be used as a locally run AI system. Like the Mac version that Perplexity launched in April, Personal Computer for Windows operates like a “general-purpose digital worker” that can access local files and apps to perform actions on your behalf, such as creating documents and updating spreadsheets.

This launch builds on Personal Computer integrations that Perplexity launched for Microsoft’s 365 workspace apps and Teams virtual meeting software in May. Personal Computer for Windows aims to bridge the remaining gap by operating directly inside the Windows environment, Perplexity said in its press release, noting that enterprise work the agentic tool is designed for typically occurs locally on Windows devices “out of AI’s reach.”

“Now Microsoft users can ask Computer to work across their local files, Microsoft Office 365, and the web in one place,” Perplexity said. “It’s built for the often messy way enterprise work gets done on local machines.”

Personal Computer for Windows is rolling out to paying Max and Enterprise Max users today, on subscription tiers that start from $200 per month. Perplexity says the tool doesn’t train on company data, and that Personal Computer for Windows always notifies users before performing sensitive actions like sending emails and deleting files.

content_html_zh:
杰西韦瑟贝德

是一位专注于创意产业、计算和互联网文化的新闻撰稿人。 Jess 在 TechRadar 开始了她的职业生涯，负责报道新闻和硬件评论。

Perplexity 已将其代理个人计算机工具扩展到 Windows，允许运行世界上最流行操作系统的计算机用作本地运行的人工智能系统。 与 Perplexity 在 4 月份推出的 Mac 版本一样，Windows 个人电脑的运行方式就像一个“通用数字工作者”，可以访问本地文件和应用程序以代表您执行操作，例如创建文档和更新电子表格。

此次发布建立在 Perplexity 于 5 月份为 Microsoft 365 工作区应用程序和 Teams 虚拟会议软件推出的个人计算机集成的基础上。 Perplexity 在其新闻稿中表示，Windows 个人电脑旨在通过直接在 Windows 环境中运行来弥补剩余的差距，并指出该代理工具设计的企业工作通常发生在“人工智能无法触及的”本地 Windows 设备上。

“现在，微软用户可以要求计算机在一个地方处理本地文件、Microsoft Office 365 和网络，”Perplexity 说。 “它是为了在本地计算机上完成企业工作通常很混乱的方式而构建的。”

Windows 个人电脑现已向付费 Max 和 Enterprise Max 用户推出，订阅级别起价为每月 200 美元。 Perplexity 表示，该工具不会根据公司数据进行训练，并且 Windows 个人电脑始终会在执行发送电子邮件和删除文件等敏感操作之前通知用户。
